title: 雨夜咖啡馆的时间循环

storyBible.worldAnchor: A cozy Chinese coffee shop interior on a rainy night, warm yellow lamplight, soft reflections, cinematic framing, steady camera focus on the protagonist.

characters.name: 主角
characters.anchorPrompt: A young adult, average build, wearing a dark hoodie and jeans, holding a ceramic coffee cup, standing in a dimly lit coffee shop.

characters.name: 朋友
characters.anchorPrompt: A close friend in a jacket, carrying a briefcase, standing beside the protagonist in the coffee shop.

props.name: Coffee Cup
props.anchorPrompt: White ceramic coffee cup with a saucer, steam visible, placed on a wooden table.

props.name: Frosted Window
props.anchorPrompt: Large frosted window with rain streaks, offering a view of a quiet street outside.

props.name: Espresso Machine
props.anchorPrompt: Black industrial espresso machine with a steam vent, placed behind the counter.

props.name: Wall Clock
props.anchorPrompt: Wall-mounted analog clock showing 3:00, classic design with brass hands.

props.name: Chalkboard Menu
props.anchorPrompt: Chalkboard with handwritten coffee options, positioned near the counter.

locations.name: Rainy Night Coffee Shop
locations.anchorPrompt: Interior of a small Chinese coffee shop, wooden tables, dim yellow lamp glow, rain visible through window, steady ambient sound.

eventChain: Opening: Protagonist realizes tonight's choice will change everyone's fate.
Choice 1: Investigate anomaly or protect companion.
Result 1: Protagonist finds a repeatable pattern behind apparent random events.
Result 2: Protagonist protects companion, missing first clue but gains deeper trust.
Ending 1: Protagonist breaks the loop, walking toward a new dawn.
Ending 2: Protagonist keeps the secret, maintaining the status quo but knowing how to choose next time.
